items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I left Claude Hopkins' band. That's the band I was with.

ctx.x: Or did you join one of these bands first?
No, no. When I came back to Kansas City the first time, I left Claude Hopkins' band. That's the band I was with. See, I left Basie down there in the Reno Club and went on off with Claude Hopkins.
